findings.title: W4 camera-tilt labels stale after the W5 pad bump: 'pucks ≈65° STEEPEST' / range 47–65° is unreachable at committed pad 1.15 — pucks render 60.8°, house (61.4°) is actually steepest; committed range is 47.3–61.4°
findings.detail: The W4 fold measured elevations before W5 bumped the puck pad 0.95→1.15 in the same PR; 65.0° = atan(9.9/(0.35+4.5·0.95)). Doc-only — the camera is computed from pad in code; re-renders proven byte-identical.
findings.recommended_fix: Re-measure from committed SPRITE_SPECS pads and relabel (~47–61°: house 61.4° steepest, pucks ≈60.8°, campus 47.3°) in the docstring, README, spec §0, and PR body; drop the pad-0.95 example.

findings.title: Gate-7 'negative self-test' is vacuous: the mutated order never passes through the comparator, so a comparator regression still passes CI green
findings.detail: mutated != of is always true for distinct filenames (the leg cannot fail), and mutated is never fed to the so/of/jo comparison — the claimed #79 r2 W4 fold ('comparator must BITE') is decorative. Contrast the working negative legs in test_sprite_foldin.py.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract the comparison into a helper and assert it FAILS on (mutated, of, jo) — mirroring sprite_guard's bite legs.

findings.title: House colorway recolor silently skips missing material slots — a deleted/renamed contract slot ships mixed-colorway sprites with no fold-in gate firing
findings.detail: if m is not None is structurally required (house has no fill_hip by design), so a missing-by-accident slot is indistinguishable: stale coral face renders while the alpha-only bbox guard stays green. Committed .blend verified correct (byte-identical re-render); latent drift risk.
findings.recommended_fix: When colorway is set, assert the family's full README-contract slot list resolves; SystemExit on a missing slot (mirroring emission_set/hex_rgba fail-loud pattern).

findings.title: Puck tier solo walks only direct scene-collection children/members — root-level or nested objects would escape it and render into every tier, passing the W5 guard
findings.detail: Committed puck.blend verified clean (tiers are the only direct children, no root/nested strays — renders byte-identical); latent: a future stray object at scene root or in a nested collection renders into all three pucks and only a later T2 mismatch catches it.
findings.recommended_fix: Walk collections recursively + include sc.collection.objects in the hide set, or assert the scene root holds exactly tier_4/8/16 as direct children before soloing.

findings.title: Committed .blend binaries embed absolute /Users/moses/... paths (wip-render filepath + file-browser recents) — the leak class this PR's N3 fold scrubbed from docs
findings.detail: zstd-decompressed blobs carry /Users/moses/.herdr/worktrees/.../assets/blender/wip/r3_*.png and recents fragments; N3 cleaned committed docs only. Private repo, so low impact — but the class violates the repo's own rule.
findings.recommended_fix: Clear scene.render.filepath (or set blend-relative '//'), purge browser recents, resave; re-verify double-run byte-identity after the resave.

findings.title: Embedded-script auto-run defense is a README policy note, not enforced by the documented pipeline command or gen_sprites.py
findings.detail: Invocation is bare `blender -b -P` with no --disable-autoexec and no use_scripts_auto_execute pin before open_mainfile; the pipeline reads committed zstd-opaque binaries and protection depends on each runner's preference state. Committed files verified script-free today.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin `blender -b --disable-autoexec -P tools/gen_sprites.py` in README/spec/docstring, and/or set use_scripts_auto_execute = False in gen_sprites.py before the first open_mainfile.

findings.title: strip_png_metadata — the determinism-critical chunk stripper (hard rule 3) — has zero automated coverage
findings.detail: Byte-identical re-render rests on this pure function plus one-off manual double-runs; a chunk-walk regression breaks determinism or corrupts PNGs with no CI net. The diff's own extract-pure-logic-for-CI convention wasn't applied to it.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract to sprite_guard.py + add a gate-7b leg: synthetic PNG with tEXt/iTXt/zTXt chunks → stripped; IHDR/IDAT preserved; chunk boundaries valid.

findings.title: All 6 committed .blends carry residue references to a hash-named external JPG (0dac0b05..._1_500x500.jpg) absent from disk, repo, and worktree — not a live datablock (bpy.data.images empty)

findings.title: lint-gated test evals gen_sprites.py's SPRITE_SPECS AST with full builtins
findings.detail: Input is the repo's own source (no untrusted boundary today), but eval rather than literal_eval executes arbitrary call expressions at lint time.
findings.recommended_fix: Make SPRITE_SPECS literal_eval-able or eval with {"__builtins__": {}, "HOUSE_COLORS": colors}.

findings.title: Puck tier solo map (puck_1→tier_4 … puck_3→tier_16) unpinned — a tier swap renders wrong-size pucks that pass every fold-in gate
findings.detail: Only SPEC keys are checked; a swapped tier value yields non-empty in-canvas renders and regenerates sprites.json silently (132/150/168-wide ladder unpinned).
findings.recommended_fix: Gate-7b leg asserting committed sprites.json puck bbox widths strictly increase (puck_1 < puck_2 < puck_3).

findings.title: README render-contract Materials row ships three cells in a two-column table
findings.detail: Header declares 2 columns; the Materials row has 3 cells, so the trailing note renders outside the table in strict Markdown.
findings.recommended_fix: Merge the third cell into the Value column or extend the header.

findings.title: Fold-in test wired as 'gate 7' in two docstrings but 'gate 7b' in lint.sh
findings.detail: Gate 7 is the sprite-order pin; the fold-in pins are gate 7b. The docstring cross-references misdirect readers tracing which gate proves W5.

findings.title: Shadow offset documented '∝ footprint' but floored at constants (max(2.5px, w·0.08) / max(3.0px, h·0.10)) — houses sit below the floor
findings.detail: At the documented 21.6px house width, 0.08·w = 1.7px < 2.5 floor → constant; larger footprints are proportional. '∝' is imprecise for the smallest sprites.
findings.recommended_fix: Document 'proportional with a 2.5/3px floor' in the comment/README/spec — or drop the floor if strict proportionality is the contract.

findings.title: 'round 1' means two different rounds in the same spec: rejected (this job's look-gate r1) and user-approved (stage-1's look-gate)
findings.detail: Round-history calls round 1 REJECTED; §1 residential cites 'user-approved round 1'. Two gates share one label — provenance misread risk.

rejected_findings.title: Regrouped-order guard in main() is tautological — SystemExit unreachable
rejected_findings.rejection_reason: Disproven by simulation: building families via setdefault over SPRITE_ORDER and flattening reproduces the order ONLY when every family is contiguous; a non-contiguous edit makes the flattened list diverge and the guard fires. Claim's premise is false.
